commentary:
Memory was updated yesterday, and most of the change is about the screen it lands on.

It keeps the day: what you saw, where, a clip if you did not want to type. Everything is encrypted at rest with a key derived from your passphrase, which is never stored.

What changed:
- The app now sizes itself to the window it is open in: type scales, and the container no longer pins everything into a narrow column.
- The landing page is a vault door now, not a card, which is closer to what the app is.
- A new test opens the page and checks it draws something, so a blank build cannot pass quietly.

What did not change, and matters more:
- Search decrypts in memory at the moment you ask. No index on disk, and no network code at all.
- The export is ciphertext. A plaintext export would be the one hole in the design.
- If storage fails, capture stops and says so, and names the oldest hour lost, rather than going quiet.
- There is no always-listening capture or transcription, because there is no speech model here; the words are typed or the clip is kept and marked.

Free, offline, no account, no telemetry. Windows, Android, Linux, or the browser.

https://drsamonline.github.io/app-memory/
